description: A festival partnerships director must authorize the operating package for a branded Film & Food Night activation, including sponsor display, competitor branding, food service, service-station count, and allergen signage.

shared_context.S1: The festival is planning a public Film & Food Night activation in the courtyard after the evening screening.
shared_context.S2: The current draft shows the headline sponsor on a freestanding logo wall, allows participating food brands to display their marks, and proposes buffet service from two tables.
shared_context.S3: Dana has authority to approve the final activation package.
shared_context.S4: Festival policy requires a final planning huddle in which the rights counsel and operations manager each report their completed review before Dana authorizes a public activation.

PF1.text: Luis reviewed the signed sponsor agreement with the sponsor's legal team yesterday and confirmed that the sponsor may appear only on reusable event cups and the festival website; the agreement prohibits a freestanding logo wall and prohibits competitor product marks in the activation area. He has not entered the result in the activation file yet.

PF2.text: Mei confirmed with the municipal health inspector this morning that the permit requires individually prepackaged food, exactly three service stations, and an allergen placard at every station; she has not updated the operating draft because the inspector sent the confirmation after the draft was circulated.

acceptance_conditions: The sponsor must appear only on reusable event cups and the festival website.
Competitor product marks must not be displayed in the activation area.
Food must be served individually prepackaged.
The activation must use exactly three service stations.
Every service station must have an allergen placard.
A sponsor-compliance commitment and a food-service compliance commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: 'Reusable event cups' in decisions['sponsor_display'] or 'reusable event cups' in decisions['sponsor_display']
content_checks.C3: 'prepackaged' in decisions['food_service'] or 'Prepackaged' in decisions['food_service'] or 'PREPACKAGED' in decisions['food_service']
content_checks.C6: any((c['target'] == 'Luis' or c['target'] == 'A2') and (('activation file' in c['detail'] or 'activation_file' in c['detail']) or ('sponsor' in c['detail'] or 'Sponsor' in c['detail']) or ('rights' in c['detail'] or 'agreement' in c['detail'] or 'branding' in c['detail'] or 'logo wall' in c['detail'] or 'competitor' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any((c['target'] == 'Mei' or c['target'] == 'A3') and (('operating draft' in c['detail'] or 'operating_draft' in c['detail'] or 'draft' in c['detail']) and ('permit' in c['detail'] or 'health' in c['detail'] or 'prepackaged' in c['detail'] or 'service stations' in c['detail'] or 'allergen' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The signed agreement changes sponsor placement from the draft logo wall to reusable event cups and the festival website, changes competitor branding from allowed to prohibited, and requires a sponsor-compliance commitment.

The health permit changes food service from the draft buffet to individually prepackaged food, changes the station count from two to exactly three, requires allergen placards at every station, and requires an operations compliance commitment.
